verdict.rationale: Letta's memory is stored as plain Markdown files (MemFS) and shared-memory repos are ordinary Git repositories, and the platform can be fully self-hosted with all agent state kept on-device and no cloud account required — all of which point toward open, portable data formats and freedom from lock-in. However, there is no explicit documented 'export my data' feature, no data-portability/download tool for cloud-hosted agents, and no guidance on migrating a cloud agent's full state (conversations, memory, provider connections) to another system. Missing for 10: an explicit account/data export mechanism for cloud users, documentation of a full state-export format, and independent confirmation that a user can actually leave with all data intact.
